purpose: Registry for RunPod Serverless endpoints (B-101 migration). One entry per endpoint = one worker image + one endpoint config + one Model Manager provider mapping. Mirrors helpers/runpod/pod-registry.json for the old pods. Every image/endpoint change MUST be recorded here and reproducible from the Dockerfile + config.
notes: Docker is NOT installed on the dev host. DEPLOYMENT = RunPod GitHub Integration (Serverless -> + New Endpoint -> "Start from GitHub Repo"; docs/deployment.md Method 2): RunPod clones DaturaInoxia/DreamGenClone, builds the worker Dockerfile, auto-updates the endpoint on every push. NO GHCR / NO GitHub Actions (the old GHCR + build-serverless-worker.yml pipeline is SUPERSEDED 2026-08-28; containerRegistry field kept for reference only).
Endpoint API field names (minWorkers/maxWorkers/idleTimeout/gpuIds) verified at P0 against the live RunPod serverless API/console before the first create.
Serverless workers have no SSH. Debugging = build -> deploy -> send job -> read job logs -> iterate.
Migration order: DWPose (infra proof, no app changes) -> Juggernaut (first app-integrated) -> identity -> Qwen VL -> Qwen Edit.

PIVOT + DEPLOYMENT (2026-08-28): all workers rebuilt FROM the OFFICIAL runpod/worker-comfyui:<ver>-base (AGPL-3.0; newest -base tag = 5.8.4) with the OFFICIAL tooling (comfy-node-install). DEPLOYMENT = RunPod GitHub Integration ('Start from GitHub Repo', docs/deployment.md Method 2): RunPod clones this repo, builds the Dockerfile, auto-updates the endpoint on every push. NO GHCR / NO GitHub Actions worker workflow (superseded). Official API contract: input.workflow (ComfyUI API JSON) + input.images[{name,image}] -> output.images[{filename,type:base64,data}]. WebSocket completion; SSH debug via PUBLIC_KEY; native network-volume support (models at /runpod-volume/models) - DEFERRED (user). Hand-rolled serverless-worker.py deleted.
Pods stay running (stopped-not-deleted) as rollback until each endpoint soaks green.
